S.FORM: Halus kwara bnkisan na Tayal ga, maki utux cyoli' hiya ga wa pcyan lalu, Halus lalu nya, ungat ima yani hi nya tyaba, trhaw babow urow hiya ga, innbyan nya hiya ga mnanak ro glahang ci, urow wayal nya snyahow ga wayan tkiyu ro nya tbutul tegan uy, mnanak ci utas nya, ungat utas ima thuyey cpung utas nya, kruyux ci utas nya knkuxun mita cyoli, iwan bni'an hwey na lutux, krryax kryax utas nya ga ble'un nya sbhul syow olu nya ro hwinuk nya kya, ana mosuw utas nya ga kba' mkukuw llyuw utas nya uy. kyaku 'lyan skura mnayang mayah kwara mlikuy utux alang hiya ga, Halus kwe ga s'agan nya kwara knba'an nya musa mgnow nya bley ci mlahang sali kwara ana ima na knerin, kyaku maki knerin knapal nya ga musa sgali' kwara pipi naha, yihul ci ga kruma knerin knahul yow kwe ro musa mhoyil uy, gbyan ana wayal ble'un ci pkat 'lu sali uy ga, Halus ga musa pwah suruw Sali naha ro kyupan nya tubung kya tyaba utas nya, musa nya ci ba'un tmring knerin nya maki iyik Sali kya, trang tyaba mwalah, s'unu ro hmor 'sya ga, plwanun nya gluw Tayal hiya musa ciyak na bcilung, skahul nya tyaba utas nya skbaley nya utux hongu, sa'ing 'ba nya ga galan sc'ruw, musa myasa wahan naha hongu. siga mlikuy pwah hongu ga musa miyiy ci wahan hongu, kyaku knerin ro krakis musa pwah hongu ga, yani ci khoni lbing khetuy ci utas nya, kryax ga musa ungat ya'eh yow mhtuw. cinkhulan sa knita' sa brbiru 江明清 Yawi‧Nomin,
S.PHON: ħalus~ɕ kwara βnkis~ɕan na tajal ɣa, maki utux ʦ~ʨjoliʔ ħija ɣa wa pʦ~ʨjan lalu, ħalus~ɕ lalu nja, uŋat ima jani ħi nja tjaβa, trħaw βaβow urow ħija ɣa, innβjan nja ħija ɣa mnanak ro ɣlaħaŋ ʦ~ʨi, urow wajal nja s~ɕnjaħow ɣa wajan tkiju ro nja tβutul teɣan uj, mnanak ʦ~ʨi utas~ɕ nja, uŋat utas~ɕ ima tħujej ʦ~ʨpuŋ utas~ɕ nja, krujux ʦ~ʨi utas~ɕ nja knkuxun mita ʦ~ʨjoli, iwan βniʔan ħwej na lutux, krrjax krjax utas~ɕ nja ɣa βleʔun nja s~ɕβħul s~ɕjow olu nja ro ħwinuk nja kja, ana mos~ɕuw utas~ɕ nja ɣa kβaʔ mkukuw lljuw utas~ɕ nja uj. kjaku ʔljan s~ɕkura mnajaŋ majaħ kwara mlikuj utux alaŋ ħija ɣa, ħalus~ɕ kwe ɣa s~ɕʔaɣan nja kwara knβaʔan nja mus~ɕa mɣnow nja βlej ʦ~ʨi mlaħaŋ s~ɕali kwara ana ima na knerin, kjaku maki knerin knapal nja ɣa mus~ɕa s~ɕɣaliʔ kwara pipi naħa, jiħul ʦ~ʨi ɣa kruma knerin knaħul jow kwe ro mus~ɕa mħojil uj, ɣβjan ana wajal βleʔun ʦ~ʨi pkat ʔlu s~ɕali uj ɣa, ħalus~ɕ ɣa mus~ɕa pwaħ s~ɕuruw s~ɕali naħa ro kjupan nja tuβuŋ kja tjaβa utas~ɕ nja, mus~ɕa nja ʦ~ʨi βaʔun tmriŋ knerin nja maki ijik s~ɕali kja, traŋ tjaβa mwalaħ, s~ɕʔunu ro ħmor ʔs~ɕja ɣa, plwanun nja ɣluw tajal ħija mus~ɕa ʦ~ʨijak na βʦ~ʨiluŋ, s~ɕkaħul nja tjaβa utas~ɕ nja s~ɕkβalej nja utux ħoŋu, s~ɕaʔiŋ ʔβa nja ɣa ɣalan s~ɕʦ~ʨʔruw, mus~ɕa mjas~ɕa waħan naħa ħoŋu. s~ɕiɣa mlikuj pwaħ ħoŋu ɣa mus~ɕa mijij ʦ~ʨi waħan ħoŋu, kjaku knerin ro krakis~ɕ mus~ɕa pwaħ ħoŋu ɣa, jani ʦ~ʨi kħoni lβiŋ kħetuj ʦ~ʨi utas~ɕ nja, krjax ɣa mus~ɕa uŋat jaʔeħ jow mħtuw. ʦ~ʨinkħulan s~ɕa knitaʔ s~ɕa βrβiru *** jawi*nomin,
